english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken term for a medication pill.
Use this when the pill is understood as a rounded medicine pill rather than a flat tablet.

examples.english: Take this pill only after a meal.
examples.traditional: 呢粒藥丸要食飯後先食。
examples.jyutping: ni1 lap1 joek6 jyun2 jiu3 sik6 faan6 hau6 sin1 sik6

examples.english: This tablet should be swallowed whole.
examples.traditional: 呢粒藥丸要成粒吞落肚。
examples.jyutping: ni1 lap1 joek6 jyun2 jiu3 seng4 lap1 tan1 lok6 tou5
